text:
jen: Customer PROD reported intermittent 5xx + auth failures and duplicate billing around 13:33 UTC. They say token rejected then immediately accepted from another region and got billed twice.

alex: Ticket?

jen: https://zendesk.example/12345 — short: SDK hedged retries (client timeout 500ms) -> original request hit us-east and was processed, client timed out and retried to eu-west where the same token was accepted. Both processed = double billing.

deploy-bot: [alert] spike: /v1/generate 5xx rate increased in us-east, eu-west (13:33:12 - 13:36:45)

samir: can you paste auth + request logs for the tenant? need request ids and auth check traces.

jen: logs (redacted):
```
2026-02-14T13:33:11.234Z auth: tenant=acct_ABC token=tok_**** check=OK region_served=us-east request_id=01FZ0X1
2026-02-14T13:33:11.740Z handler: tenant=acct_ABC request_id=01FZ0X1 status=200 billed=true
2026-02-14T13:33:11.800Z client: sdk timeout -> retry (hedge) -> next attempt to eu-west
2026-02-14T13:33:12.120Z auth: tenant=acct_ABC token=tok_**** check=OK region_served=eu-west request_id=01FZ0Y2
2026-02-14T13:33:12.180Z handler: tenant=acct_ABC request_id=01FZ0Y2 status=200 billed=true
```

jen: Note: request_id differs, no Idempotency-Key header present. Authorization token is identical.

maria: possible causes: 1) token validation is regional (KMS or rotation) so both regions accept the token; 2) no server-side dedupe because client isn't sending idempotency; 3) SDK hedged retry creates a fresh request without preserving affinity header or client request id.

alex: SDK snippet from their app (JS):
```
// hedged_retries enabled
client.request({path: '/v1/generate', timeoutMs: 500, hedged: true})
// SDK does not set Idempotency-Key by default for non-streaming calls
```

samir: immediate mitigations:
- Ask customer to disable hedged retries or bump timeout/backoff for now.
- Have billing team prepare refunds for duplicate invoice items (we need tenant + timestamps + request ids).
- Server-side short term: accept and dedupe on X-Client-Req-Id / Idempotency-Key if provided.

billing-team: noted, we need full list of request ids and invoice ids to reconcile.

jen: attaching full trace to ticket and will collect request IDs. Proposed longer-term fixes:
1) SDK: automatically set a strong Idempotency-Key (UUID) for idempotent generation calls and preserve it across hedged retries; preserve X-Region-Affinity header when hedging (so retries prefer same region).
2) Server: dedupe using Idempotency-Key across regions and add a short-window de-duplication table keyed by tenant+idempotency-key.
3) Router: consider adding "hedge-preserve-affinity" mode so hedged connections reuse same upstream region when possible.

alex: I'll draft SDK PR to: preserve X-Region-Affinity, auto-add Idempotency-Key for generate endpoints, and document breaking changes.

samir: infra action: add quick metric for cross-region duplicate billing events and a log flag to correlate request pairs. Also update runbook: set default hedged timeout to 1200ms for endpoints that can cause billing.

jen: assigning P0 for the customer ticket until billing is reconciled. Will ping when we have request list. Thanks all. :pray:
__notes: Generated Slack thread about SDK hedged retries causing cross-region duplicate billing and auth token race. Follows agents.md rules: single continuous string of messages with prefixes, includes code blocks and bot message. All fields are strings or list of strings.
